name: DeviceExplorer
description: Device explorer: filter + search toolbar over a sortable, selectable device table. Shows the miner columns by default; pass `columns` to change them (spread `getMinerColumns(...)` to extend the defau…
descriptionFull: Device explorer: filter + search toolbar over a sortable, selectable device table. Shows the miner columns by default; pass `columns` to change them (spread `getMinerColumns(...)` to extend the default set). Designed to be controlled by URL state in the host app

props.name: columns
props.description: Table columns. Defaults to the miner columns ({@link getMinerColumns})

props.name: getFormattedDate
props.description: Date formatter from the host's timezone setup; used by the default miner columns

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Called when a row is clicked (e.g. to open the device's detail page)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Category key at the top level (e.g. `status`), or a selectable value under it; selections reach `onFiltersChange` as `[…
fields.descriptionFull: Category key at the top level (e.g. `status`), or a selectable value under it; selections reach `onFiltersChange` as `[category, value]` paths

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text shown in the filter cascader

fields.name: children
fields.description: Values selectable under this category; omit on leaf options

fields.name: value
fields.description: Tag added to `searchTags` when this suggestion is picked (free-text tags are also allowed)

fields.name: label
fields.description: Suggestion text, matched case-insensitively against the typed query and shown on the chip
